title: Nice bike ride in Sierra Norte
text: A very beautiful bike ride through the Sierra Norte nature reserve. One enthusiastic guide tells fun facts about the Iberian pigs and the surroundings. Top restaurant! In short, a recommendation!
author: 531veerles

title: Fabulous Biking Trip in Sierra Norte National Park
text: We had a terrific day    Carlos was a great guide   Very friendly and knowledgeable  The scenery was beautiful   Lunch was amazing at Bar La Plaza in San Nicolas del Porto  - migas was a local specialty and delicious   They were flexible with us when we had to shift the schedule some   The 10 of us had a wonderful day   We highly recommend them!
author: Tour30252726444

title: The Best Tour Experience We Had in Spain
text:
Our experience with Andalucia Tours & Discovery was absolutely exceptional and ended up being one of the highlights of our entire Andalusia trip. We were looking for something authentic, thoughtful, and deeply connected to the culture of southern Spain — not a generic tourist experience — and this delivered perfectly.

title: Wonderful trip outside the city
text:
Wonderful tour with excellent guide and guidance.
Along the way excellent local food.
Highly recommended for those who want to make a more extensive trip and enjoy nature and culture outside the city.
author: 642ludyv

title: Bike rental
text: I rented a bike here to drive the Via de la Plata. The service was excellent: good communication and the bike was in perfect condition. I wanted to leave the bike in Cáceres in stead of Salamanca and that was no problem. I strongly recommend! Echt wel een aanrader! Mucho gracias!!
author: Greet v

title: Loved it -  Road north to the...
text: Loved it - Road north to the National park area about an hour drive from Seville- tour started in small quaint town where our guide Carlos was greeting by everyone. The tour took us through the lovely park with a nice variety of scenery and biking - from road to bike paths. Stopped for lunch along the way note, you need to bring euros - no credit cards taken. Carlos was a super guide. Would definitely recommend.
author: patricia_p

title: Great Countryside Bike Tour
text: we participated in the "Countryside Bike Tour" and met at the office at 9:00 am and had a great day in the Sierre del Norte, where we were guided personally by Carlos, who informed us with great passion about the wildlife and the farming in the mountains north of Seville. We can highly recommend the "Countryside Bike Tour" and since the bikes you hire are e-bikes, anyone can manage the rather hilly route. Thanks again for a great day.
author: Ole C
